{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

'''Vegetable soup''' is a [[Cookbook:soup|soup]] made from [[Cookbook:vegetable|vegetable]]s. Many different recipes and variations are possible.

{{1881}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:onion|onion]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:turnip|turnip]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:potato|potato]]es, pared
* 1 [[Cookbook:carrot|carrot]]
* 1 head of [[Cookbook:celery|celery]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:pint|pint]]s water
* 1 slice of [[Cookbook:bread|bread]], toasted and buttered

==Procedure==
#Boil the onion, turnip, potatoes, carrot, and celery in the water until the vegetables are cooked.
#Insert the bread into a bowl. Pour the soup over it.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* [[Cookbook:Tomato|Tomatoes]] also make a welcome addition to the soup. 

[[Category:Soup recipes]]
